_note: Register fragment for publication-withdrawal-aftercare (REQ-PWA-002). The depublication says what the public tombstone of a withdrawn publication tells a reader: a public reason beside the internal one, and whether it names the title. The version is the depublication schema's merged version, so the last fragment in name order (woo-x-access-boundary-hardening.json) carries the same bump.

publicReason.title: Public reason
publicReason.description: Why the publication was withdrawn, as the public link tells a reader.
